trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Matrix multiplication inputs have incompatible inner dimensions, e.g. (1,1) and (2,1), or more generally (m,k) and (k',n) with k != k'.
trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: Default tensor type is set to torch.cuda.DoubleTensor or another CUDA floating-point default type.
trigger_condition.state_trigger: torch.set_default_tensor_type(torch.cuda.DoubleTensor) causes newly created tensors in nn.Linear or torch.mm to be CUDA tensors.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.mm or nn.Linear executes on CUDA tensors with incompatible matrix dimensions.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Set default tensor type to a CUDA floating-point type; create CUDA matrix tensors whose inner dimensions do not match; pass them to torch.mm or nn.Linear; CPU execution of the equivalent shapes should raise a shape mismatch error.

root_cause.aten_layer: CUDA path of torch.mm lacks the input shape compatibility check that the CPU path applies.

bug_oracle.description: Expected behavior is a shape mismatch RuntimeError as observed on CPU; CUDA path may not raise the expected error and may return incorrect output.
bug_oracle.signal: Missing RuntimeError or shape mismatch exception on CUDA execution

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate torch.mm and nn.Linear inputs with incompatible inner dimensions, varying shapes such as (1,1) against (2,1) and other mismatched (m,k)/(k',n) combinations.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct tensors on CUDA by setting the default tensor type to a CUDA floating-point type or by explicitly placing tensors on cuda.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject CUDA default dtype/device state and enforce matrix dimension mismatches, including small, large, and broadcast-like shapes where k != k'.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.mm or nn.Linear with CUDA tensors whose inner dimensions are incompatible; execute the same operation on CPU tensors as a reference.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare CUDA behavior against CPU behavior: CPU should raise a shape mismatch exception; if CUDA returns a result or fails to raise the expected RuntimeError, record as a bug.
